# Vazirmatn

Vazirmatn by Saber Rastikerdar, version 33.003, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt).

Source: https://github.com/rastikerdar/vazirmatn/tree/v33.003/fonts/ttf

Regular (400), Medium (500), SemiBold (600) and Bold (700) are bundled in `app/src/main/res/font`. Font files are unmodified. Persian letters and Persian digits in all four weights were checked before bundling.
